6.80 rsInvalidFieldNameLength
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidFieldNameLength is a critical error that will occur when the value of the Name attribute of a
Field element is either empty or is longer than 256 characters.
